title: A shared shopping list
description:
Share one list between several owners with `Rc<RefCell<...>>`.

```
Ada adds milk
Bob adds eggs
both see: [milk, eggs]
owners: 3
Bob's view after Ada's list is dropped: [milk, eggs]
```
hints: `self.list.borrow_mut().push(item.to_string())` changes the vector through a shared reference; `RefCell` checks the borrow rules while the program runs (lesson 5.04).
`Rc::clone(&list)` makes a new owner without copying the vector.
requirements: `struct Person { name: String, list: Shared }` with `fn add(&self, item: &str)` (note: `&self`, not `&mut self`).
Print `Rc::strong_count` and show the list stays alive while any owner exists.
stretch: Make a tree of nodes where children hold a `Weak` link back to their parent.
